description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for a captcha extension in OpenCart, including methods for rendering the captcha, validating user input, and generating the captcha image.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for handling basic captcha functionalities in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language and view for the captcha, setting the captcha text in session data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the user's captcha input against the stored session captcha.

methods.name: captcha
methods.description: Generates a captcha image with random ellipses and draws the captcha text on it.
